feat(winter-test-service): support deleting items

Adds DELETE /api/items/{id} through the repository seam (WriteItemRepository.delete_item),
a service-layer ItemNotFoundError mapped to 404, and a per-row delete control in the web UI
that removes the row from state without a full page reload.
